en.title: Skyrim's New IKEA Kallax Companion is Voiced by Matt Berry
en.summary: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim is getting a bizarrely brilliant official IKEA mod that introduces a fully-voiced Kallax storage unit companion. Matt Berry, known for his iconic comedic roles, lends his booming baritone to this unexpected in-game ally.
en.body:
Forget dragons and Daedric Princes for a moment; the latest threat to Tamriel might just be an overstuffed inventory. In a move that nobody saw coming, **IKEA** has officially partnered with the **Skyrim** modding scene to bring a piece of its iconic furniture into the game as a fully-fledged companion. Meet **Kallax Storageborn**, a sentient Kallax shelving unit voiced by the inimitable **Matt Berry**. Yes, you read that right. The man who brought us the legendary Laszlo Cravensworth is now lending his distinctive, booming voice to a piece of flat-pack furniture.

This isn't just a cosmetic gag; the **Kallax Storageborn** creation, developed by **Kinggath Creations**, offers a substantial addition to the game. Players can summon their new storage-savvy friend with a custom Dragon Shout, aptly named AYE-KEY-YAH. The primary function, as expected from an IKEA product, is to help manage your ever-expanding hoard of loot, preventing that all-too-familiar feeling of being hopelessly over-encumbered. But the collaboration goes deeper, featuring a unique questline with two new IKEA-themed dungeons and even a boss fight against the dreaded Clutter Golem. Players can also equip themed items like the Dwemer Allen Key weapon and a Meatball Helmet, adding to the playful absurdity.

## A Storage Solution for the Dragonborn

IKEA’s foray into the world of **The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim** is a testament to the game's enduring legacy and its massive modding community. The company sees this as a way to extend their brand's ethos of improving everyday life – even if that life is lived within a fantasy realm. "At IKEA, we believe in creating a better everyday life for the many people — and why shouldn't that include their digital lives?" stated IKEA executive Kemi Anthony. "Skyrim possesses one of the largest modding communities in gaming, and we saw a space where our expertise in functional storage could make a real difference in this fantasy world." The choice of **Matt Berry** was deliberate, with Anthony adding that his "distinctive, legendary voice brings theatrics, booming authority and charm to the new Creation." This collaboration cleverly taps into a common player frustration – inventory management – and turns it into a delightful, albeit surreal, gameplay feature.

## The Community Assembles

For the dedicated **Skyrim** player base, this official mod is a dream come true, blending a beloved franchise with an unexpected, yet fitting, brand partnership. The enthusiasm is palpable, with fans eager to experience the unique quest and, of course, hear **Matt Berry**’s voice emanating from a piece of furniture. It’s a celebration of **Skyrim**’s unparalleled modding scene, which consistently proves its ability to innovate and entertain, now even attracting official brand endorsements. This isn't just about carrying more loot; it's about the sheer joy and surprise of seeing such a creative crossover come to life, offering a fresh, humorous take on a long-standing game mechanic.

## What's Next

The **Kallax Storageborn** creation is set to be available for free on September 9, 2026. Players will be able to download and integrate this unique companion into their **Skyrim** adventures, adding a touch of IKEA practicality and **Matt Berry**’s undeniable charm to the frozen north.

content_raw: What We Do in the Shadows' Matt Berry voices an IKEA Kallax bookcase in a free official Creation for The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim . The infamous IKEA storage unit will become a fully-fledged in-game companion, Kallax Storageborn, able to carry your items and prevent you becoming easily over-encumbered. You'll even be able to summon him with a custom Dragon Shout (AYE-KEY-YAH). Yes, IKEA. Why is Berry being roped in to lend his baritone boom to a bookcase? Well, this is an officially-licensed IKEA collaboration that plays on the infamous annoyance of being over-encumbered within the game. But there's seemingly more here than just a simple joke. Not only have Berry's talents been secured, but developer Kinggath Creations has crafted a full quest with two new IKEA-themed dungeons, and a boss fight against the Clutter Golem. Need help assembling your inventory? You'll also be able to wield the Dwemer Allen Key weapon, wear the Meatball Helmet, and gobble meatball food items. "At IKEA, we believe in creating a better everyday life for the many people — and why shouldn't that include their digital lives?" said IKEA exec Kemi Anthony. "Skyrim possesses one of the largest modding communities in gaming, and we saw a space where our expertise in functional storage could make a real difference in this fantasy world. "Matt Berry's distinctive, legendary voice brings theatrics, booming authority and charm to the new Creation. In bringing Kallax to life we hope to not only make a meaningful difference for Skyrim players but doing so with a touch of added IKEA playfulness to delight gamers who've long been bogged down by too much stuff." This isn't Berry's first video game credit, of course. You can hear his dulcet tones right now in LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight as Bane, or in the celebrated 2024 British indie adventure Thank Goodness You're Here! It's a busy time for Berry, who is due to appear next year in both Sonic the Hedgehog 4 and A Minecraft Movie Squared. This year, he'll appear as The Fish in a new Bill Hader-starring adaptation of The Cat in the Hat. The IKEA Kallax Storageborn add-on Creation will be available to download for free via Bethesda Game Studios in-game Creations menu from today, September 9. Image credit: IKEA.
